mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RC_RESULT (RECON_DT, TID, TX_ST_CD, DIFF_TYPE, US_AMT, PG_AMT) SELECT #{reconDt}, t.TID, t.TX_ST_CD, 'ONLY_US', t.AMT, NULL FROM TR_MSTR t LEFT JOIN IN_PG_TRX p ON p.RECON_DT = #{reconDt} AND p.TID = t.TID AND p.TX_ST_CD = t.TX_ST_CD WHERE t.TR_DT = #{reconDt} AND t.PM_CD IN ('CARD', 'VACNT') AND p.SRC_SEQ IS NULL

INSERT INTO RC_RESULT (RECON_DT, TID, TX_ST_CD, DIFF_TYPE, US_AMT, PG_AMT) SELECT #{reconDt}, p.TID, p.TX_ST_CD, 'ONLY_PG', NULL, p.AMT FROM IN_PG_TRX p LEFT JOIN TR_MSTR t ON t.TR_DT = #{reconDt} AND t.TID = p.TID AND t.TX_ST_CD = p.TX_ST_CD WHERE p.RECON_DT = #{reconDt} AND t.TR_SEQ IS NULL

INSERT INTO RC_RESULT (RECON_DT, TID, TX_ST_CD, DIFF_TYPE, US_AMT, PG_AMT) SELECT #{reconDt}, t.TID, t.TX_ST_CD, 'AMT_MISMATCH', t.AMT, p.AMT FROM TR_MSTR t JOIN IN_PG_TRX p ON p.RECON_DT = #{reconDt} AND p.TID = t.TID AND p.TX_ST_CD = t.TX_ST_CD WHERE t.TR_DT = #{reconDt} AND t.PM_CD IN ('CARD', 'VACNT') AND t.AMT <> p.AMT
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM RC_RESULT WHERE RECON_DT = #{reconDt} ORDER BY DIFF_TYPE, TID
SELECT DIFF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM RC_RESULT WHERE RECON_DT = #{reconDt} GROUP BY DIFF_TYPE
